text_block_list.text:
Since Ines Fuujin wasn't feeling well, I 
decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you're such a worrywart. Well, 
fine, I'll take it easy and rest~."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
"...Agent Ines, infiltration successful. 
The lavalier mic seems to be working well 
too."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? Infiltrate...? What are you 
talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
"Quiet. Aren't you the one who applied for 
a part-time spy job?"

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
"Listen carefully. Head up to the upper 
floors just like this, and covertly seize 
the physical evidence. The fate of the 
world rests upon your shoulders!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...! Come to think of it, did I 
apply a little while ago...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm the one who applied, I've gotta 
see it through properly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Could this pearl be the physical 
evidence? Must be, since it's got a tag 
that says 'Physical Evidence' on it."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If I just take this and run away for now—

text_block_list.name: Evil Syndicate Guard A
text_block_list.text:
Who's there! Intruder spotted on the 7th 
floor! Requesting backup!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? This is bad! We gotta get away 
fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Evil Syndicate Guard B
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Gah! Gliding smoothly 
just like a seagull on the wind—!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! I just can't afford to lose from 
the front!

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, Agent Ines! Thanks to you, the 
world is saved!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hooray... I saved the world~... ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, oh, it was just a dream~! Must've 
been that anime I watched with Su-chan and 
the others!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I slept great, and I even saved world 
peace in my dream. All's well that ends 
well~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! To think they'd get ahead of us! At 
this rate—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My work was a failure~~!

Ines Fujin seems to have had a bad dream, 
and remained feeling under the weather.
